description: zkSync: trustless scaling and privacy engine for Ethereum
readme_summary: > **⚠️ Deprecation Notice** > > ZKSync Lite is being deprecated. To withdraw your funds, please visit > lite.zksync.io. If you prefer to generate your withdrawal proof independently rather than use the web interface, you can use the Exit Tree Generator. The flow is three steps: Download the snapshot of the ZKSync Lite state at the last verified block from: The archive contains `accounts.csv`, `balances.csv`, and `tokens.csv`. **Mainnet:**: https://etherscan.io/address/0x0a14b696350546110a0d8acdb86226983af9d2a0 - **`claim`** — withdraws the funds to the caller (`msg.sender`). Use this when the wallet submitting the transaction is the address that held the ZKSync Lite account. - **`claimTo`** — withdraws the funds to a specified recipient address. Use this when you want the funds sent somewhere other than the caller (for example, a cold wallet or a different EOA).
